N001.summary: Early game phase with light or uncertain production and technology investment. Maintain current development path, keep production and technology balanced, and avoid overcommitting to any single strategy.
N001.title: Early Game Development
N001.trigger_summary: Early game phase with light or uncertain production and technology investment.

N002.summary: Early-midgame phase, still with light or uncertain production and tech, but with more game time elapsed. Maintain current development, but start to lean toward a ground-oriented army if you have scouted no air threat.
N002.title: Early-Midgame Consolidation
N002.trigger_summary: Early-midgame phase, still with light or uncertain production and tech, but with more game time elapsed.

N003.summary: Midgame phase, with light or uncertain production and tech, but now leaning toward ground army. Maintain current army path, focusing on ground units, while continuing to develop economy and tech.
N003.title: Midgame Ground Focus
N003.trigger_summary: Midgame phase, with light or uncertain production and tech, but now leaning toward ground army.

N004.summary: Late-midgame phase, with light or uncertain production and tech, but with a stable economy. Maintain current development, but start to consider late-game tech and upgrades.
N004.title: Late-Midgame Stability
N004.trigger_summary: Late-midgame phase, with light or uncertain production and tech, but with a stable economy.

N005.summary: Early game with moderate production and heavy technology investment. Increase production and strengthen ground army, while continuing tech development.
N005.title: Early Game Tech Investment
N005.trigger_summary: Early game with moderate production and heavy technology investment.

N006.summary: Midgame with heavy economy, production, and tech, and a ground-oriented army. Strengthen ground army, increase economy, and continue tech development.
N006.title: Midgame Ground Macro
N006.trigger_summary: Midgame with heavy economy, production, and tech, and a ground-oriented army.

N007.summary: Early-midgame with moderate production and heavy tech, ground-oriented. Strengthen ground army, increase economy, and continue tech.
N007.title: Early-Midgame Ground Tech
N007.trigger_summary: Early-midgame with moderate production and heavy tech, ground-oriented.

N008.summary: Early game with moderate production and heavy tech, ground-oriented. Strengthen ground army, increase economy, and continue tech.
N008.title: Early Game Ground Tech
N008.trigger_summary: Early game with moderate production and heavy tech, ground-oriented.

N009.summary: Early-midgame with heavy economy, production, and tech, ground-oriented. Strengthen ground army, increase economy, and continue production and tech.
N009.title: Early-Midgame Heavy Ground
N009.trigger_summary: Early-midgame with heavy economy, production, and tech, ground-oriented.

N010.summary: Midgame with moderate air presence, heavy economy, production, and tech, ground-oriented but with air units. Increase air presence, strengthen air army, and continue economy and tech development.
N010.title: Midgame Air Transition
N010.trigger_summary: Midgame with moderate air presence, heavy economy, production, and tech, ground-oriented but with air units.

N011.summary: Midgame with heavy economy and tech, moderate production, and a defensive ground posture. Increase defense, strengthen ground army, and continue economy and tech development.
N011.title: Midgame Defensive Ground
N011.trigger_summary: Midgame with heavy economy and tech, moderate production, and a defensive ground posture.

N012.summary: Early-midgame with heavy production and tech, moderate economy, and unknown army composition. Strengthen ground army, increase economy, and continue production and tech.
N012.title: Early-Midgame Heavy Production
N012.trigger_summary: Early-midgame with heavy production and tech, moderate economy, and unknown army composition.
